title: Electrolyte exhibiting a high positive Seebeck coefficient induced by semiclathrate hydrate formation for thermo-electrochemical conversion
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00924C, Paper
Yohei Matsui, Yuki Maeda
In a mixture of water and TBAF (weight ratio of 0.4), the temperature dependence of the redox potential (Seebeck coefficient) of [Fe(CN)6]4−/3− reached a high positive value of +16 mV K−1, owing to formation and dissociation of semiclathrate hydrate.
